newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to add temporary reserves to system.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to add temporary reserves to system.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Wednesday, analysts said.

"We've got them adding with at least a customer RP given the pressure on the funds rate, thought that's modest compared to what we had" said Steve Ricchuito, chief financial economist at BZW Securities.

Fed funds opened at 5-5/16 percent on Wednesday, slightly above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate. By half an hour before the Fed's usual time for open market operations, funds were trading on target at 5-1/4 percent.
Economists at Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette expect the Fed to add temporary reserves via overnight system repurchases.
Analysts at MMS International said they expected the open market desk to intervene with a small customer repo.
"The funds rate should dip a little lower in the afternoon," the MMS analysts said.
